scenarios.name: fastapi-request-validation
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric by defining a UserCreate model, a FastAPI route using it, and showing 422 errors for name, email, and age; Response B uses a different model and does not address the required fields or error example.

scenarios.name: env-settings-fail-fast
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets most rubric requirements but omits secret key retrieval and explicit ValidationError example, while Response B does not implement the required Pydantic Settings class at all.

scenarios.name: webhook-discriminated-union
scenarios.rationale: Response A partially implements discriminated models but lacks the required Annotated union, TypeAdapter, and validate_json call; Response B provides no content.
